progress_events.note: Implementing explicit-instance app-server connection ownership in the assigned new adapter file; lib.rs module registration awaits nonblocking core coordination with Terra.

Explicit Codex instance spawn is implemented in the owned file and passes isolated process/environment/reap checks. Commit is rebased to current origin/main; core registration remains Terra's integration step.

changes.result: Added crates/herder/src/adapters/codex/connection.rs and acceptance/contracts/codex.md in commit c30bd5b5, rebased onto fresh origin/main 9060361c. CodexInstance makes instance ID, executable, CODEX_HOME and cwd explicit; CodexConnection owns one app-server child and stdio pipes, clears inherited environment and fixes HOME/CODEX_HOME to the selected profile, exposes process/profile identity, and kills/reaps the child on drop. Standalone rustc harness passed 2/2 in a loopback-only network namespace: rejects empty instance before spawn, starts official Codex app-server for the selected isolated profile, verifies process CODEX_HOME/HOME and no OPENAI_API_KEY, then verifies child is reaped. Evidence: /home/roomhacker/.codex/worktrees/herder-codex-native/agent-herder/.tmp/v052b-codex-profile-20261107/connection-build.log and connection-smoke.log. Full Cargo integration not yet proven because core-owned lib.rs wiring is pending Terra.
